task: Make parallel sub-agent orchestration the enforced default for Claude Code in this repository: the work-plan check must reject a plan that serialises independent workstreams, reject an unjustified solo plan, and require an explicit model per assignment matched to the risk tier

interface_contract.scripts/team_plan_check.cjs: checkPlan(plan, options) keeps its current signature and every existing finding code unchanged. It gains: (1) result.warnings = [{code,message}], non-failing, never affects result.ok; (2) result.builders[].model; (3) result.workstreams = number of weakly-connected components of the builder dependency graph, and result.parallelBuilders = number of builders whose depends_on contains no builder. New FAILING codes, exact spelling: model_missing, model_invalid, model_underpowered, reviewer_model_underpowered, parallel_dispatch_missing, solo_justification_missing. New WARNING code: model_overpowered. New exported helper: planAreas(paths) returning sorted distinct area names.
interface_contract.plan schema additions: Every assignment REQUIRES model, one of exactly haiku, sonnet or opus. Optional top-level strings plan.solo_justification and plan.serialization_justification, each meaningful only when at least 40 characters after trim.
interface_contract.area mapping (planAreas): docs/ or a root-level *.md maps to docs; tests/ or external-tests/ maps to tests; web/ frontend/ assets/ android/ ios/ map to frontend; src/migrations/ or supabase/ map to database; any other src/ maps to backend; scripts/ maps to tooling; .github/ maps to ci; config/ maps to config; anything else maps to its first path segment.
interface_contract.rule parallel_dispatch_missing: Fires when there are at least 2 builders and parallelBuilders is less than 2, meaning every builder but one waits on another builder, unless plan.serialization_justification is at least 40 characters.
interface_contract.rule solo_justification_missing: Fires when there is exactly 1 builder whose allowed paths span at least 2 areas, unless plan.solo_justification is at least 40 characters.
interface_contract.rule model_underpowered: A builder with a non-empty risk family list must declare model opus.
interface_contract.rule reviewer_model_underpowered: A reviewer with senior === true must declare model opus.
interface_contract.warning model_overpowered: A builder with no risk family that declares opus and is not agent claude-lead produces the warning only; result.ok is unaffected.
interface_contract.risk matrix addition: The ci-gates family additionally matches the plan and route gate tooling itself: scripts/team_plan_check.cjs, scripts/agent_router.cjs, scripts/agent_readonly_bash_guard.cjs. HIGH_RISK_PREFIXES ci-gates gains the scripts/ prefix.
interface_contract.output lines: TEAM_PLAN_WARN <code> <message> for warnings. TEAM_PLAN_BUILDER lines gain a trailing model=<model> field. TEAM_PLAN_SUMMARY JSON gains warnings, workstreams and parallel_builders keys.

overlap_decision: The checker reports one open_work_overlap: CLAUDE.md is also touched by origin/codex/bootstrap-reconcile-20260924 (PR #79, last commit 2026-09-24, 26 commits behind master). The owner asked for CLAUDE.md explicitly, and under the AGENTS.md source-of-truth order the owner's current task outranks the inter-agent scope lock. The collision is made harmless rather than merely accepted: PR #79 appends a single Optional specialist team section at end of file, B3 inserts strictly above the final completion-report section and leaves the last three lines byte-identical, so the two hunks are disjoint. This is proven mechanically before merge with a trial three-way merge that must report zero conflicts. The other two listed branches touch only PROJECT_STATUS.md, and B0 writes only the claude slot.
retroactive_finding_note: On 2026-09-28, later in the same change that produced this plan, scripts/team_plan_check.cjs reclassified tests/release_tools/team_plan_check.test.cjs as ci-gates, because a CI step now runs that file to enforce this very gate and whoever can empty its assertions can switch the gate off. The builder in this plan that holds that file declares model sonnet, so the current checker reports model_underpowered against this plan. The recorded model is deliberately NOT being changed to opus: that builder really did run on sonnet, and editing a record to satisfy a rule created after the run is precisely the model_fabricated behaviour this same change added a detector for. The rule is right, this plan violated it, and both facts are left visible. Senior review was satisfied in this plan; only the model-tier floor is unmet. Recorded in PROJECT_STATUS.md and in docs/team-plans/2026-09-28-orchestration-enforcement-round3.json.
